name: PLAYORA
description: PLAYORA is a free browser gaming platform. Play action, puzzle, arcade, racing and more games instantly on your computer, tablet or phone. No downloads, no sign-up.

categories.name: Puzzle

categories.name: Arcade
categories.blurb: Classic quick-play fun. One more try, one more high score.

categories.name: Sports
